title: Perform an as-of feature join
prompt: As-of feature-join reference. Requests are (entity,cutoff); versions are dicts with entity,event_time,available_time,version,value. Select the greatest (event_time,available_time,version) eligible tuple where BOTH timestamps <=cutoff. Return selected row copies or None in request order. This O(R*V) core prioritizes the temporal contract.
